1.consolidated_definition: Insecto ortóptero de color verde, herbívoro, de cabeza gruesa con ojos prominentes, antenas finas, y patas posteriores, robustas y largas, que le permiten dar grandes saltos. Acrididae, Acridium spp.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Orthopteran insect of green color, herbivorous, with a stout head and prominent eyes, fine antennae, and robust and long hind legs that enable it to make large jumps. Acrididae, Acridium spp.
